original_speech_situation: During an emotional face-to-face reunion, Maria asks whether the speaker's apparent love is genuine, lasting, and not something he will regret the next day. He answers with the focal avowal as part of a longer declaration explaining what he loves about her.
undertaking_and_uptake: The focal phrase itself does not clearly undertake an obligation. A separate neighbouring statement—“Du er den, jeg vil dø med, men først vil jeg leve meget, meget længe med Dig.”—presents a lifelong shared future and may imply relational commitment. Maria's tears and happiness show uptake of his speech principally as truthful; the passage does not separately record explicit acceptance of defined undertaking terms.
